page: Vultr voc-c-32c-64gb-1000s-amd is an Optimized Cloud Compute server powered by an AMD EPYC x86_64 processor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. Local storage is bundled and consists of a 1000 GB NVMe SSD. No GPU hardware is included in this configuration, which also includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark results indicate strong performance characteristics across multiple vectors. The AMD EPYC processor delivers top-tier single-core CPU performance in stress-ng tests, ranking in the top 10 percent, while multi-core performance is strong, placing in the top 25 percent. Memory subsystem performance is highly competitive, with PassMark memory scores reaching the top 10 percent and large-block read-only memory bandwidth measured at 346.3 GB/sec. For specialized workloads, the server demonstrates top-tier text generation speeds for small and medium LLM inference models, alongside strong multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and Redis SET operations.

From a resource allocation perspective, this server offers a compute-heavy profile with dedicated CPU resources, making it highly cost-efficient for workloads requiring sustained CPU utilization without the overhead of excess memory. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio combined with high-speed NVMe storage makes this instance well-suited for multi-threaded compilation, database operations, Redis caching layers, and CPU-based machine learning inference.
